programmes.d: In this futuristic, action-packed thriller, a cop and his robotic partner enter the Zone, a forbidden section of the city inhabited by a disease-stricken populace. Together, they discover the real reason everyone is sick, and attempt to stop the illness.
After finding his brother murdered after returning from duty, Webster (Michael Jai White) searches for the perpetrators, but discovers a conspiracy that cuts deep inside the U.S. government.

After botching a hit, Tommy Ward flees to L.A. and strikes a deal: mentor his boss's awkward son in exchange for a way home. But a routine job turns into a night of gunfights, killers, and chaos as the odd duo battles to survive-and earn redemption.
Santa's workshop is in financial peril and to make matters worse, a disgruntled boy puts a sizable hit on the fatman's (Mel Gibson) head after receiving a lump of coal for Christmas.
